pixelate_image: HTTP fallback for relative path reads without COMFYUI_PATH, save_dir on pixelate_image/export_for_engine, asset registration via registerLocal(). 2032 tests passing.

remove_background: added mode luma_key (comfy-core-only luminance key: LoadImage -> 3x ImageToMask -> 2x MaskComposite(add) -> [ThresholdMask] -> [GrowMask] -> InvertMask -> JoinImageWithAlpha -> SaveImage), with optional threshold/softness. Verified structurally via validate_workflow and end-to-end against live ComfyUI (hollow-center test: background+hollow center alpha=0, ring alpha=255 -- exact BiRefNet failure mode fixed). 2039 tests passing.

Wired unconditional validateWorkflow(workflow, {health:false}) into enqueueSpriteJob right before submit (sprite-job.ts) -- both generate_sprite and generate_animation_set funnel through it. A malformed/missing-model graph is now caught before hitting ComfyUI instead of failing async at runtime.

Added auto_download_missing (explicit opt-in, default false) to generate_sprite/generate_animation_set. On validation failure due to missing model(s), resolves the best CivitAI/HuggingFace candidate (liveResolveDeps, refactored out of resolve_missing_models into services/missing-models.ts), downloads it via downloadModel/resolveCivitaiModel(Version), rewires the workflow to the actually-installed filename, resets the client-side object_info cache, and re-validates before enqueue. No candidate found -> actionable error, never a broken checkpoint. Reports downloaded_models in both tools' results. LoRA wiring (7dc.1) explicitly out of scope. 12 new unit tests (sprite-job.test.ts) + 3 propagation tests (generate-animation-set.test.ts). Full suite: 175 files / 2054 tests passing.

Added steps/cfg/sampler/scheduler overrides to generate_sprite/generate_animation_set (same pattern as generate_image), threaded via SpriteJobRequest.stepsOverride/cfgOverride/samplerOverride/schedulerOverride into buildSpriteWorkflow's shared KSampler params -- unblocks the Flux-schnell case (cfg 1.0, 4-8 steps) without touching graph construction. checkpoint-resolver.ts's resolveSpriteCheckpoint now returns {checkpoint, familyMismatchWarning?}: an explicit warning (not just logger.info) when the style's family-mapped fallback lands on a checkpoint from a different base-model family than the style expects, echoed as checkpoint_warning in both tools' results. cfg=1.0/negative-prompt-inert caveat documented in the cfg param description (closes report P4 note). 18 new tests (checkpoint-resolver.test.ts x9, sprite-workflow.test.ts x4, generate-sprite.test.ts x5) plus the family-mismatch propagation test added to sprite-job.test.ts. Full suite: 178 files / 2073 tests passing.

pixelate_image: added output_size/output_scale (mutually exclusive) to render the quantized logical grid larger on disk via nearest-neighbor resize applied AFTER despeckle -- grid/palette/cleanup passes are untouched. QuantizeOptions.outputSize threaded through quantize.ts; result.width/height now report the final (possibly upscaled) dims, with new grid_width/grid_height in the tool summary reporting the logical grid size separately. Alpha verified preserved through the upscale. 12 new tests (quantize.test.ts x4, pixelate-image.test.ts x4 new + existing updated). Full suite: 179 files / 2081 tests passing.

1) view_image: new background param ('dark'|'light'|'checker') composites transparency server-side before returning (always PNG) -- fixes the client-default-white-composite confusion for dark/neon pixel art. 2) analyze_color: toRaw() no longer strips alpha (RGB stats unaffected, verified with a regression test); new computeAlphaStats() adds an alpha section (transparentPct/semiTransparentPct/opaquePct/meanAlpha), omitted entirely (not present in the JSON) when the source has no alpha channel. 3) New generic tool contact_sheet(asset_ids[], background?, columns?) -- tiles N assets (need not share dimensions, unlike pack_spritesheet) onto one shared backdrop (default dark) for batch QA, replacing the PowerShell+System.Drawing script from the report. Registered at the end of TOOL_GROUPS to preserve tools/list order. 25 new tests across view-image.test.ts, color-analysis.test.ts, contact-sheet.test.ts, plus a strengthened quantize.test.ts alpha assertion (discovered and fixed a flawed test-construction pattern: sharp's composite blend modes recompute the whole canvas from the source's bounds, not just the placed region -- raw-buffer construction is the reliable way to punch a localized transparent hole in test fixtures). Full suite: 181 files / 2101 tests passing.
